quest.title: Pirate Invasion, in Liyue Harbor!
quest.description: There's a group of kids who are very eager to play a pirate-themed game...

talks.objective: Talk to Little Lulu, Little Fei, and Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: So. How shall we play it this time?

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hmph. If no one's going to be the pirate, we can't play it at all.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But no one wants to be a pirate. So what're we gonna do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: We were gonna play a game, but there's no one to be the pirate.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: If there's no pirate, there's no one to do the robbing... so we can't start the game.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Ooh, ooh, I know, you can do it! Do you want to be a pirate?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: When you're ready, come and join in.

choices.text: Pirating is not my area of expertise...

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: It's not that hard! A pirate is just someone who is very naughty and takes things that don't belong to them.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: I've never met a real pirate though. That's just what Beidou told me.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: But I think it must be quite easy to play a pirate.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Hehehe, I'm sure you can do it! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ready!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Then let the game begin!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: ...How do we start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... Shiver me timbers? I'm robbing you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Eek! Pirates!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lulu, I'll save you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: You must be a pirate. Tell me, why are you robbing us?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Not all of them. There are good-guy pirates and bad-guy pirates.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Beidou says she's a pirate, but she's one of the good guys. She gives us snacks! Everyone loves Beidou.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Why you gotta be a bad pirate? Can't you be a good pirate instead?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're the one who said pirates are naughty people who take things that don't belong to them!

choices.text: I see the error of my ways.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Great! Owning up to your mistakes is the first step towards becoming a better person. That's what Beidou says.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: The next step is tidying up the area. Because as long as you do good things, you can be a good person. Even a good pirate.

talks.objective: Use Anemo or Hydro to clean the deck

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Finished cleaning yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Finished.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Yay! Thanks, these are for you. It was fun playing with you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: And don't forget — being a good person doesn't stop here. Make it a habit for life.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hey, when do I get to be the captain?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Next time.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: That's what you said last time...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Finished cleaning?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hurry up. This is your chance to change your ways and show you can be a good person.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Hey, are we seriously saying that just cleaning up the place once turns you into one of the good guys?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: All it takes to be a good person is the willingness to do the right thing.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: That sounds too simple...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Do good, you're a good person. Do bad, you're a bad person. Yes, it's very simple.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Huh. You may say so, but then how come there's still so many bad people in the world?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Because everything in the world is easier said than done.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: But doing bad things is still easier than doing good things.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Did Beidou teach you that?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Nah, that one I read in a book.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Okay, just let me know when you're ready then.
